title: Inventory
html:
15.3.1Stock history per warehouse

By entering the characteristic parameters of the product, a stock movement report can be queried for any period.

15.3.2Current stock

By entering the characteristic parameters of the product, a stock report can be queried for a given point in time.

15.3.3Aged stock analysis report

Querying the stock of a given warehouse or warehouses for a point in time in the past. It follows the purchase price changes — in the case of a subsequent price change, it shows the modified price for the given period.
